# kaleido_platform_permission_set (Data Source)

Read a permission set by name or id: a built-in set (such as admin, full-access or platform-api-user) or one made elsewhere, to give it in a grant. Needs access grants on (the access_grants toggle).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A built-in set by name, to give it in a grant
data "kaleido_platform_permission_set" "full_access" {
  name = "full-access"
}

# Everything in one service, for an application
resource "kaleido_platform_grant" "ci_km1" {
  name              = "ci-km1"
  application_id    = kaleido_platform_application.ci.id
  permission_set_id = data.kaleido_platform_permission_set.full_access.id
  params_json       = jsonencode({ service = kaleido_platform_service.km1.id })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the set. Specify either id or name
- `name` (String) Name of the set. Specify either id or name

### Read-Only

- `builtin` (Boolean) Whether the set is built in, and so read-only
- `description` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `params_json` (String) The params the set declares, which a grant of it fills
- `permissions_json` (String) The set's permissions
